summary: Verified /compare filter pill fix. Skin Care pill now correctly shows 3 skincare-tagged peptides (GHK-Cu, Argireline, KPV) with expandable price rows. All other pills (All, Vials, Aminos) and popular pill (Tirzepatide) work as expected.

issues: Some price rows show '0mg' size resulting in '$Infinity' per-mg (Peptide Tech, Scantifix). Data-quality issue, not scope of current fix but worth flagging.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix at PeptideAccordion rows filter is correct: skip physical-form filter for category pills. Consider centralizing the 'is category vs form' check (e.g., const PHYSICAL_FORMS = ['vial','capsule','liquid']) so both visiblePeptides and PeptideAccordion share the same logic to avoid future drift.
Data hygiene: some prices have size_mg=0 producing $Infinity per-mg — either hide these rows or guard against divide-by-zero in the price/mg display.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing preview DB (GHK-Cu, Argireline, KPV already tagged skincare).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter pills on /compare verified. testids: form-all/vial/capsule/liquid/skincare/aminos, card-header-<slug>, card-body-<slug>, pop-<slug>, compare-search. Backend GET /api/comparison returns peptides with category field.

test_results_detail.ghk_cu_expanded: Body visible; shows 5 vendor price rows (Solas, Felix x2, Peptide Tech, Scantifix)
test_results_detail.tirzepatide_popular: Search box populated with 'Tirzepatide', filtered to 1 card
